message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters dominates the top. The background mimics a United States banknote, featuring intricate line patterns and circular seals. Centered is a large portrait of a man, rendered in the engraved style of a bill. He faces forward, wearing a dark suit and tie. His eyes are wide, and his mouth is open with his tongue protruding.

To the left, large black text reads "Duit Labora Bicara." Above this, smaller text states, "Polisi pemilik rekening Rp 1,5 triliun ini membeberkan nama atasan yang pernah ia kucuri uang." At the top, two headlines read "MENTERI GITA DAN KARTEL KEDELAI" and "KEJANGGALAN CERITA PENEMBAKAN POLISI." A red border frames the left and bottom edges. The bottom left features a barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and pricing text "RP 33.000." A small banner under the man’s portrait contains the word "LABORA." The date "EDISI 23-29 SEPTEMBER 2013" appears in small print. Overall, the composition blends traditional currency aesthetics with journalistic typography.
